title: Drownings at unguarded beaches
summary: Ocean safety reported three drownings at unguarded beaches in September 2024, and in August 2026 said Maui had 14 drownings that year, all at unguarded beaches. Ocean safety added roving patrols during a hurricane, and a captain said unguarded-beach drownings could be added to junior lifeguard lessons.

timeline.text: Up to 600 young people applied, but 450 was what the program could take.
An ocean safety captain said drownings at unguarded beaches could probably be added to the junior lifeguard lessons.
The junior lifeguard program served about 450 young people this year, up from 300 in 2025.
During the recent hurricane, ocean safety added roving patrols in each district to reach beaches without lifeguards.
The ocean safety chief said Maui has had 14 drownings this year, all at unguarded beaches.
Ocean safety officers responded to three drownings at unguarded beaches.
